status: proposal-only; no candidate capture, render, product edit or adoption performed
goal: Compare whether quieter surface texture, neutral room colour and controlled edge highlights make the current Catalog feel more like a coherent OS component. This first comparison isolates window material; it does not claim to finish shape, typography or interaction design.

sourceVerification.method: Read and byte/SHA256 check against the R5 manifest; import current DEFAULTS and inspect glassMaterial/fragment consumers. No candidate applied.

semantics.albedo: Linear RGB transmission colour; actual window shading also applies absorption and the legibility scrim.
semantics.maxLum: Input to the adaptive luminance scrim, not a measured contrast guarantee.
semantics.knee: Retained room luminance gradient above maxLum.
semantics.sat: Fraction of room colour retained after luminance mixing.
semantics.frost: Fragment normal perturbation amplitude; does not alter CPU vertices.
semantics.key: Window specular, silhouette and bevel light multiplier.

historicalReference.status: Historical unadopted R4 proposals only. Window values are re-read against R5 before being proposed again; R4 images are not current R5 comparison evidence.
historicalReference.r5Difference: R4 B changed shared look.glass.blur to 0.26. R5 keeps it at current 0.36 because glassMaterial shares this field with window, lens and icon bead materials. No historical adoption is inherited.

scope.applicationMethod: A future isolated bench run may deep-merge the exact profile override with ?set= before construction. Verify actual producer ESM URLs, complete DEFAULTS equality to canonical plus allowlisted overrides, and live window shader uniforms. Do not mutate repository defaults or tokens.
forbiddenChanges: geometry, dimensions, corner positions, arrow geometry, font shaping, text metrics, icons, content, camera or environment
opacity hierarchy, title opacity, contact glow, input thresholds, motion or source/owner handling
product/preview source, shared tokens or generated files
scope.rationale: Only the window-specific fragment material varies. Icon beads, side/corner bubbles and input feedback remain the existing R5 controls, so adjacent visual changes cannot be mistaken for improvements to the window material.

profiles.label: Current · 현재 R5
profiles.intent: Verified R5 control with no material override.

profiles.label: A · 차분한 반투명
profiles.intent: Reduce the warm room tint, visible grain and strong specular edge while retaining depth and the existing luminance scrim.
risksToInspect: A flatter surface may weaken separation between overlapping windows.
Less highlight may make handles feel visually disconnected even though their shader is fixed.

profiles.label: B · 분명한 유리 경계
profiles.intent: Keep a stronger room luminance gradient and polished edge than A, with a quieter surface than current. Shared transmission blur stays fixed.
risksToInspect: Brighter albedo and retained room gradient may compete with secondary text.
Edge light can remain decorative or distracting; it is a candidate, not a measured readability improvement.

recommendation.status: Recommendation for comparison order only; user adoption pending.
recommendation.reason: Current R5 still shows strong room tint and surface grain in the verified Catalog capture. A directly tests whether reducing those effects improves the perceived finish while leaving geometry, text, icons and input intact. B preserves more material depth as a second direction. Retain current if both reduce legibility or hierarchy.
selectionChoices: no candidate accepted; report a concrete revision
questionsForUser: Which surface looks most like an everyday OS component?
Can you still read the title/body and distinguish the active window from its parents?
Does held feedback remain clear without the handle or border dominating?

fixedConditions.environment: Pinned Lebombo HDR, yaw 1.6; unchanged original product tone mapping/exposure
fixedConditions.typeAndIcons: Same pinned font/assets and actual shaped text metadata; no fallback, restyling or glyph replacement is permitted.
fixedConditions.input: Replay the exact verified source/owner fixtures and stable state; never substitute index press for pinch hold.

conditions.reason: Judge the main material, label hierarchy, texture and polished outline.
Confirm that the same 12 mm/6 mm actual movement, unchanged side bubble and held opacity still read clearly.
Compare a visible rear sheet and restored title using the accepted layer fixture.
Compare three-level depth and rear hierarchy at the accepted oblique camera.

boundedMatrix.layerCondition: Use only the final audited R5 layer contract and its exact fixture, camera, diagnostic sampling and per-view N/A policy. Modular/front historical aggregate failure stays preserved. No Catalog or camera change to manufacture visible pixels. Missing final layer acceptance blocks the entire comparison matrix.

executionGates: This file authorizes no capture. The existing lookdev owner must explicitly dispatch the prepared bounded comparison after the following gates; current task remains plan-only.

Complete the final R5 evidence audit: controls 9+5, the accepted layer matrix and Dock/Push traces, image/file hashes, source/contract/code pins and unit errata. A partial current audit is insufficient.
Freeze profile values and new comparison code/settings hashes; read the final layer contract hash from the accepted audit. Missing or changed pins fail closed.
Compare canonical and candidate full DEFAULTS with an exact leaf allowlist. Read the actual producer ESM instance and window uniforms; shared glass, icon, bubble and glow settings must be identical.
Use fresh exclusive outputs. Verify the complete 91 input files before and after. No output reuse, repeated unknown-state dispatch, material fallback or implicit source promotion.

For each condition, establish identical current/A/B camera, real input trace and stable frames, root pose/scale, visible geometry/index buffers, input-driven vertex deformation parameters (dent/bulge), text shaping/font/glyph bounds, icon canvas alpha and fixed non-window uniforms. Only the allowlisted window fragment material and normal parameters may differ. Any other mismatch rejects that candidate capture.
Verify actual text/icon readiness, no browser/shader errors, original HDR/colour settings and output image size/hash. maxLum=0.13 is held constant but is not accepted as proof of text contrast.

Present same-condition images with neutral labels and current included; inspect actual-size details before user choice. Do not infer Quest performance, optical equivalence or design adoption from desktop images.

nextTwoSteps.ownerRole: existing XR lookdev owner with independent reviewers
nextTwoSteps.scope: Finish the current R5 audit and pin this proposal plus the accepted layer contract; prepare a bounded current/A/B capture runner and fixed-condition fingerprint checks.
nextTwoSteps.validation: Code review, source/profile allowlist checks, fail-closed unknown profile/state/output checks; no product code or token edit.
nextTwoSteps.startCondition: Existing owner dispatches implementation within approved comparison scope; this plan does not start capture.

nextTwoSteps.ownerRole: existing XR lookdev owner; existing design coordinator obtains user choice
nextTwoSteps.scope: After all gates, capture at most 12 actual WebGL comparison images, verify exact fixed-condition invariants and assemble a labeled comparison.
nextTwoSteps.validation: Actual current/A/B image hashes and state invariants, independent image review, current vs A vs B selection with reasons.
nextTwoSteps.startCondition: No new rendering is authorized by this document. Product integration remains blocked until a concrete user selection and scope handoff.

limitations: No new candidate image, renderer run, remote action or product change was performed for this plan.
R5 held BubbleHandle dent/squash has no supported normalized Blender evaluated-geometry export; browser-only comparison does not establish Blender or optical equivalence.
Synthetic XR source and select events do not validate thumb-index recognition, device tracking, Quest comfort or real-device performance.
R5 dimensions and numeric visual values remain trial values; current/A/B is not adoption.
Historical R4 strict calibration remains 2 PASS / 4 FAIL, unwaived and separate from R5 material comparison.
